hint: You can paste a secret reference instead of the secret, like op://vault/item/field or vault://secret/app#password. It is fetched from your secret source when connecting.
title: Secret sources
description: External password managers Termix reads secrets from when you connect: 1Password Connect, Infisical, Bitwarden Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, or Bitwarden and Vaultwarden through bw serve. Tokens are stored encrypted on the server and never sent back to the browser.
tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current token
required: Name, server URL and the login details are required

privateEndpoints.label: Private endpoint allowlist
privateEndpoints.description: Private or loopback hosts a secret source may reach, one per line. A self-hosted server, like 1Password Connect, Vault or bw serve, usually needs its own address listed here.

plugin.name: Secret Sources
plugin.description: Pull host passwords and keys from 1Password, Bitwarden, Infisical or HashiCorp Vault when you connect instead of storing them in Termix.
